CustomField.description: The email addresses of the users who receive the error digest, separated by commas. Each must belong to an active user of this org; empty sends it to every active user holding Manage Nonprofit Settings (C-23, R-E5).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave empty to send the digest to everyone with the Nonprofit Admin role, or list your users' email addresses, separated by commas.
CustomField.label: Error Digest Recipients
